title: Pantheon RuntimeBinding
description: The canonical state of an active or historical artifact loading onto a specific runtime instance. Write authority: Execution Plane (Runtime Manager) only.

binding_id.description: Unique identifier for this specific binding instance.

runtime_id.description: Identifier for the actual LEAN instance, container, or worker process.

capital_pool_id.description: The capital pool this binding is servicing.

artifact_id.description: The ID of the approved artifact being executed.

artifact_version.description: The specific version of the artifact.

deployment_mode.description: The actual execution stage of the runtime (equivalent to 'stage' in L1 docs).

execution_mode.description: The runtime execution mode emitted to runtime and telemetry surfaces. Must equal deployment_mode; kept explicit so canary is not collapsed into live.

effective_at.description: Timestamp when this binding became active.

retired_at.description: Timestamp when this binding was replaced or terminated. Required when status is retired or failed.

status.description: Current operational status of the binding.

plan_id.description: Reference to the DeploymentPlan that triggered this binding. Required — no binding may exist without a backing DeploymentPlan.

persona_capital_binding_id.description: Reference to the PersonaCapitalBinding that authorises the deployment scope. Required — provides the governance admissibility proof linking runtime state back to the governing binding.

rollback_parent.description: binding_id of the RuntimeBinding that this binding replaced via rollback (if applicable).

rollback_action_type.description: The specific rollback strategy used if this was a rollback transition.
